common.sampleData: Demo mode: the apps and files shown here are examples, not from your PC. Real scanning is coming in the next versions.

home.subtitle: Here is what you can do to free up space.
home.appsText: Remove programs you don't use, along with the files they leave behind.
home.filesText: Old downloads, huge files, duplicates and forgotten installers.
home.leftoversText: Folders left behind by programs you already uninstalled.
home.mapText: See at a glance what takes up the most space.
home.quarantineTip: Nothing is deleted right away: everything goes to Quarantine for {days} days and you can restore it with one click.

apps.title: Apps

files.undone: Done: everything is back where it was.

quarantine.restoreFailed: Could not be put back and are still in Quarantine: {count}.

settings.themeHint: System follows the light or dark mode chosen in Windows.

settings.restorePointHint: Windows asks for permission. A restore point protects programs and settings; your files are protected by Quarantine.
